name: patient_is_undergoing_operation_on_abdominal_region_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently scheduled for an operation on the abdominal region.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently scheduled for an operation on the abdominal region.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently scheduled for an operation on the abdominal region.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently scheduled for an operation on the abdominal region.

when_unknown: Set to null if the expected 30-day mortality rate is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined preoperatively.
when_value: Set to the value of the patient's expected 30-day mortality rate (in percent) as recorded preoperatively.
